scope: Original Pages archive/restore lifecycle with synthetic local state
implementation: Archived pages excluded from live lists and token/sync writes
Restore retains canonical Yjs document bytes
Archive operation receipts replay without applying action twice
Permanent deletion is logical within demo state; canonical files retained
limitations: Personal pages only; nested pages and spaces not implemented
Permanent delete and archive-operation polling covered by unit tests, not yet UI
Recents reappearance verified after reload; immediate recents refresh not established

runtime.title: Archive lifecycle demo
flow: Trash > Pages lists page with deleted date
Reload > Space > restored Recents item > original editable body
